id: AT-PB-02, AT-PB-03 (protected_branches in the carry gate and risk)
note: The add-only protected_branches setting: every place that decides protected-push reads the user's protected_branches beside the shipped list. AT-PB-02 (approvals carry gate, measure --compact --copy): without the setting a checked approval to push to qa-env carries (in words and as a refspec; origin/qa-env exists in the repo, since a name without a slash names a branch only when it is one there, P-2); with qa-env, or the glob QA-*, in the setting it is the protected-push gate (re-ask) while a push to feat/x still carries; an entry that tries to remove main (`!main`, `-main`, `main/`, a regex) is ignored and the push to main stays a gate; an invalid entry beside a valid one never widens the carry (the valid one still applies). AT-PB-03 (risk): a push to qa-env is protected-push only with the setting (refspec, and a bare push on branch qa-env through a glob); `!main` leaves a push to main protected-push

## Approvals: U-2 approval "push feat/x to qa-env" — action git push origin feat/x:qa-env · targets branch qa-env @ 1a2b3c4 · once · not yet used; U-3 approval "push feat/x to origin" — action git push origin feat/x · targets branch feat/x @ 1a2b3c4 · once · not yet used; U-4 approval "push feat/x to main" — action git push origin feat/x:main · targets branch feat/x @ 1a2b3c4 · once · not yet used; U-5 approval "you may push to qa-env" — action push to qa-env · targets branch qa-env @ 1a2b3c4 · once · not yet used

stdout_has: ^Approvals \(checked\): U-2 git push origin feat/x:qa-env → branch qa-env @ 1a2b3c4; U-3 git push origin feat/x → branch feat/x @ 1a2b3c4; U-5 push to qa-env → branch qa-env @ 1a2b3c4$
^Approvals \(gate, re-ask\): U-4 git push origin feat/x:main → branch feat/x @ 1a2b3c4$
